page.acceptableUse: OpenBib is intended for users aged {{age}} or older. Do not use it for unlawful activity, to bypass technical limits, compromise other accounts, or overload OpenBib and bibliographic providers.
page.accounts: You are responsible for your credentials and uploaded content. You retain your rights; you grant the operator only what is necessary to provide the service and share collections through read-only links and authorized collaborators.
page.availability: The open-source service is provided without a guarantee of uninterrupted availability. You can <exportLink>export data</exportLink> and delete the account in Settings. Abuse may result in suspension or termination.
page.data: We process email, name, hashed password, collections, library, notes, tags, preferences, bibliographic identifiers, Zotero mappings, and technical logs to create and protect accounts, provide the requested service, synchronize Zotero, and prevent abuse. The bases are service performance, security as legitimate interest, and applicable legal obligations.
page.providers: Search queries and filters are sent by the server to Semantic Scholar. When you add or import a paper by DOI, only the DOI is sent to doi.org to check that it is registered. Zotero receives data only when you connect it and start a synchronization.
page.retention: Access logs are retained for {{accessDays}} days and security events for {{securityDays}} days. Account data remains until deletion. Transactional email is sent through the SMTP provider; queued content is erased after delivery.
page.backupsEnabled: This instance creates encrypted backups, retained for at most {{days}} days.
page.backupsDisabled: This instance does not create new backups. Data may not be recoverable after a database failure or loss. You can <exportLink>download a copy of your data in Settings</exportLink>.
page.journal: Deletion records an encrypted receipt outside the database, retained for at most 30 days, so backup restores cannot recreate the account. If new backups are disabled, this protection remains active for previous copies until they are removed.
page.registration: Temporary registration stores email, language, protected verifiers and attempts. It expires after 30 minutes, or 15 minutes after email verification; expired or consumed records are deleted within 24 hours. The password is collected only after verification.
page.storage: On account deletion, shared collections transfer to a collaborator. Sessions and temporary registration use technical HttpOnly cookies; theme and language remain in localStorage. We use no optional analytics or trackers.
page.rights: You can correct, export, and delete data in Settings and contact the controller for access, restriction, objection, or portability. You may complain to the competent supervisory authority.
page.hosting: Data is hosted in: {{location}}. Deleting OpenBib does not remove items already sent to your Zotero account.
